patch_description: Replace the placeholder (all points at origin, giving score 0) with a deterministic pipeline: (1) a strong symmetric initial configuration of 11 points inside the equilateral triangle, (2) a fixed-seed stochastic local search (simulated-annealing-style perturbation refinement) that directly maximizes the true minimum triangle area over all C(11,3)=165 triplets, with a time budget so runtime stays bounded. Area computation is fully vectorized with numpy for speed. Determinism is ensured via a fixed RNG seed and a fixed iteration budget, with a graceful fallback to the initial configuration if the refinement ever fails.
